name: Python Programming
description: Ability to write, debug, and optimise Python code including core syntax, standard library, data structures, functions, and OOP concepts.

name: Data Structures
description: Understanding and implementation of core data structures including arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, and graphs.

name: Algorithm Design
description: Ability to design and analyse algorithms including complexity analysis, divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, and greedy approaches.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Proficiency in vectors, matrices, linear transformations, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and matrix decompositions (LU, SVD, QR).

name: Probability and Statistics
description: Understanding of probability theory, random variables, distributions, statistical inference, hypothesis testing, and regression.

name: Machine Learning
description: Ability to design, train, evaluate and interpret machine learning models for supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised tasks.

name: Deep Learning
description: Proficiency in deep neural network architectures including CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, attention mechanisms, and transformers.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Ability to design and apply NLP pipelines for text preprocessing, language modelling, sequence labelling, and downstream NLP tasks.

name: Computer Vision
description: Ability to implement image processing, feature extraction, object detection, and segmentation algorithms using classical and deep learning methods.

name: Database and SQL
description: Proficiency in relational database design, SQL querying, normalisation, indexing, and transaction management.

name: Data Mining
description: Ability to apply data mining techniques including frequent pattern mining, association rules, classification, and clustering to large datasets.

name: Reinforcement Learning
description: Understanding and implementation of RL algorithms including MDPs, dynamic programming, Q-learning, and policy gradient methods.

name: Big Data Processing
description: Ability to design and run scalable data pipelines using Hadoop, Spark, and distributed computing frameworks.

name: Optimisation
description: Understanding of convex optimisation, linear programming, gradient-based methods, and constrained optimisation used in ML and operations research.

name: AI Ethics and Fairness
description: Ability to identify, measure, and mitigate algorithmic bias and to reason about ethical implications of AI systems.

name: Calculus
description: Proficiency in differential and integral calculus including multivariable calculus, partial derivatives, and applications in engineering and ML.
